exact_statement: For n>=64, independent R_n symmetric +/-1 and B_n~Bernoulli(exp(-sqrt(n))) give X_n=n^{1/3}R_n+(n/4)(B_n-p_n). The bounded variables Y_n=3n/2+X_n lie in [n,2n], Var X_n~n^{2/3}, and sup_n E exp(|X_n|/sqrt(n))<infinity; nevertheless for every a<1/2 and alpha>0, E exp(alpha|X_n|/n^a) diverges. Thus the exponential upper threshold is 1/2 and the lower variance threshold is 1/3.
assumptions: abstract random-variable family, not an FPP metric or iid-edge construction
